name: Open Mirroring
description: Open Mirroring, is a powerful feature that enhances Fabric’s extensibility by allowing any application or data provider to bring their data estate directly into OneLake with minimal effort. By enabling data providers and applications to write change data directly into a mirrored database within Fabric, Open Mirroring simplifies the handling of complex data changes, ensuring that all mirrored data is continuously up-to-date and ready for analysis.
